raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Rows from the new 'v2' collector have txn_ts shifted +6h, so they start at 12:00 instead of 06:00 like legacy and wrap past midnight into the next date. This explains the 00:00-06:00 rows, the 31 rows on 01-19, and a max txn_ts (01-19 04:55) later than that batch's ingest_ts (01-19 02:00). Subtracting 6h from v2 timestamps in silver restores the correct txn_ts and txn_date.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.72,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
